historical_record.description: The upsloping lot was vacant apart from a garage structure at its front; a permit application proposed a five-storey-over-garage three-family house behind it.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Building Inspection's issuance of a permit to erect a building with a three-unit condo with 1,320 square feet of ground floor area at 31 Hancock Street, granting the permit with conditions on cornices, entryways, bay windows and paint colors.
